purpose: Catalog operations overview for SHRESTA asset and category management.
businessRules: The admin root must summarize SHRESTA-BE asset, category, ACL, and pending-review data through API calls.
Do not expose frontend-only layout/copy controls in the admin overview.
Use the overview to show DAM/taxonomy data coverage, asset hygiene, review snapshot, and direct links to asset/category/review operations.

Top-level admin overview copy should stay operations-friendly and avoid casual backend/internal jargon; use display terms like catalog data coverage, details, fields, read source, facet mapping, and governed updates where the exact payload key is not required.
Product-facing SKU bindings are handled through backend asset metadata, not frontend static image lists.
Backend network failures and backend API 404 responses render AdminApiUnavailable instead of the Next runtime overlay.
